job.title: Data & AI Engineering (2027 Grads)
job.pay_full: $92,000 – $116,500 a year starting pay / salary range; total rewards include salary, bonus (if applicable) and benefits

details.about: Procter & Gamble is hiring 2027 graduates into its Data, Analytics & AI Engineering roles at the Cincinnati General Offices. New hires join as Data Engineers, AI Engineers or Data Asset Managers and use data and new technology to solve business problems and support data-driven decisions.
duties: Data Engineer: design, build and maintain cloud-based data and analytics platforms and pipelines that acquire, cleanse, transform and publish data
Data Engineer: develop large, complex datasets and apply coding standards to build efficient, scalable, reusable components
AI Engineer: lead proof-of-concept work to evaluate emerging technologies and advanced models
AI Engineer: build well-tested software, data models, feature engineering, ETL/ELT pipelines and scalable distributed architectures, and deploy and monitor solutions on cloud platforms
Data Asset Manager: lead data governance in assigned areas and oversee data quality, operations, storage, master data, standards, security and metadata
needs: Graduating in Spring or Summer 2027 with a Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, Applied Math, Statistics, Analytics or a similar degree
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with programming experience in a language such as Python, SQL or R (no specific language required; you'll be expected to learn new ones)
Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI) and data management practices
Ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical colleagues
nice: A history of solving complex problems with innovative solutions
Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform
Understanding of data governance and data quality best practices
Relevant experience or coursework in data analysis, data management or related fields
details.benefits: Starting pay / salary range $92,000 – $116,500 a year. P&G says pay depends on factors such as office location, role, degree, skills and experience, and total rewards include salary, bonus (if applicable) and benefits; your recruiter may share more during the hiring process.
notes: Immigration sponsorship is not available for this role
Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities during the online application
